caption: The drawing depicts a single, clear glass bottle with a round stopper on top. The bottle has a wide, round base that narrows into a long neck, crowned by a flat, circular rim at the opening. The stopper is spherical and also made of glass. On the body of the bottle, there is a decorative design consisting of clustered small dots representing grapes, with curling vine-like lines and two broad leaf shapes on either side of the cluster. The overall color scheme of the drawing is monochromatic, composed of various shades of gray, suggesting the use of pencil or ink on an off-white or beige background. There are no additional objects or prominent features in the composition; the focus is solely on the detailed rendering of the glass bottle against a plain background.
title: Decanter
